hints.title: Stride Periodic Block Inversion
hints.text: The reversal pattern repeats every 2k characters: reverse the first k characters of each 2k block, and leave the following k characters unchanged.

hints.title: Segment Boundary Clamping Invariant
hints.text: At block index i, the reversal range begins at i and ends at the minimum of i plus k minus one and string length minus one.

hints.title: Step Traversal Two Pointer Procedure
hints.text: Convert the string into a mutable character array. Step an index pointer in increments of two times k. For each step, set left to current index and right to min(index plus k minus one, length minus one). Swap characters inward using two pointers. Join and return.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(N) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Rebuilding substrings at each slice allocates multiple intermediate strings and causes O(N^2) memory copying.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Modifying the character array in place in stride 2k processes each character at most twice in O(N) time and O(N) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle trailing fragments shorter than k or between k and 2k cleanly using min bounds.
